# Source: The Girl by the Window

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** The Girl by the Window
- **Artist / culture:** Edvard Munch (Norwegian, 1863–1944)
- **Date:** 1893
- **Style:** Post-Impressionism
- **Classification:** oil on canvas
- **Department:** Painting and Sculpture of Europe
- **AIC artwork ID:** 154235
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/154235
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/d7df2633-3b40-f570-c906-211503a37cde/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** City at Night

## Extracted source palette

`#483838, #787888, #484858, #8898A8, #282828, #685868, #684848, #6888A8`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#151515`
- `surface`: `#303030`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#6888A8`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#684848`
- `surface_variant`: `#303030`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#555554`
- `error`: `#6888A8`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `20dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `17.17:1`, surface `12.41:1`
- Variant contrast: `12.41:1`
- Control contrast: `5.28:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
